opennyai_summary.facts:
During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested on 23.11.2024 and subsequently, remanded to judicial custody.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
He has been granted regular bail by the Sessions Court in the cases which are registered by Madikeri and Virajpet police stations.
In the case registered against him by Gonikoppa Police Station, this Court has granted regular bail to him by even date order passed in Crl.P.No.354/2025.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is only an employee in the Society and he has no control over the management.
He has fully co-operated with the police for the purpose of investigation.
He is in custody from 23.11.2024.
In the other two cases registered against the petitioner with the similar allegations by Madikeri and Virajpet police station, petitioner has been already enlarged on bail by the Sessions Court.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Investigation of the case is completed and the charge sheet has been filed.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the same is imprisonment for a period of seven years.
Accordingly, the following:-
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.76/2024 registered by Kushalnagar Town Police Station, Kodagu, for offences punishable under Section 406, 420 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 21, 22 and 23 of Banning of Unregulated Schemes Act, 2019, subject to the following conditions:
a) Petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
b) The petitioner shall appear regularly on all the dates of hearing before the Trial Court unless the Trial Court exempts his appearance for valid reasons;
c) The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly threaten or tamper with the prosecution witnesses;
NC: 2025:KHC:15225 d) The petitioner shall not involve in similar offences in future;
e) The petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Trial Court without permission of the said Court until the case registered against him is disposed off.
Sd/-
